# Prosper

> Dr George Collins is a UK performance and longevity doctor and the founder of Prosper, a private, doctor-led longevity and performance medicine practice (also known as Prosper Clinic). Prosper combines a comprehensive blood panel, a 60-minute consultation with Dr George, a written personal plan and structured follow-up. It is a private, self-funded service, run by Dr G Collins Ltd (company number 16388031, registered office 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ).

Dr George Collins is a GMC-registered doctor (GMC number 7658884). His qualifications are BSc(Hons) MBChB PGDipSEM DipFSEM. His background is in Emergency Medicine and Sports and Exercise Medicine. He works as an Immediate Care Doctor in professional rugby, teaches clinicians in longevity medicine at Apex Longevity Academy, and is completing an MSc in Sports and Exercise Medicine at the University of Bath. He also holds a first-class degree in chemistry.

## Who it is for

- Business owners, executives and founders who want a proper clinical review of energy, recovery, cardiovascular and metabolic risk and long-term health.
- Athletes, coached clients and serious performers who want doctor-led medical insight alongside their training.
- Anyone who wants a doctor to read their blood results in context and turn them into a plan, rather than receive a report with no explanation.

Prosper complements a client's GP and coach. It does not replace primary care and it is not an occupational health or employer screening service.

## How it works

1. Apply at /apply and book a complimentary 15-minute telephone discovery call with Dr George. There is no obligation and no medical detail is needed at this stage.
2. Secure onboarding, then one baseline blood panel completed close to home.
3. A 60-minute doctor consultation, where history, goals and results are considered together.
4. A written, personal action plan, followed by an 8 to 12 week implementation period.
5. A 45-minute follow-up review, then a clear recommendation for what comes next. Prosper Continuum provides structured ongoing support for clients who want it.

Consultations are mostly virtual and available across the UK, with in-person appointments in Bath. Costs are explained to every client before they decide to proceed. Prices are not listed on this website.
